references.label: Bannon's “flood the zone” philosophy
references.evidence: A world decimated by Bannon’s central political philosophy, which he best summarized in 2018 as, “The real opposition is the media. And the way to deal with them is to flood the zone with shit.”

references.label: Bannon and Epstein's 2018 Europe scheming
references.evidence: Based on the emails and texts we now have between the two men, they gossiped and schemed with each other as Bannon traveled Europe in 2018, attempting to franchise his far-right populist movement across Europe.

references.label: Trump's 2017 statement dismissing Bannon
references.evidence: Trump, when he dismissed Bannon in 2017, wrote, “Steven pretends to be at war with the media, which he calls the opposition party, yet he spent his time at the White House leaking false information to the media to make himself seem far more important than he was.”
